author: johncasper
quote:
The storyline of this game his the worst of any GTA game I played. Jason has no soul, no personality, and Lucia is a annoying girlfriend who always thinks she’s better than anyone else.
She literally downgrades the whole game and no, I’m not exaggerating.

If you stripped away all the graphics and detail, this game would be very very bad. I hope Rockstar listens to the real fans of GTA and make changes in the future.
